methodology.cftc_snapshot: CFTC data are Tuesday positions released later; availability timestamps prevent look-ahead.
methodology.normalization: CFTC net positioning is long minus short divided by that report row's CFTC open interest.
methodology.position_change: Gross-long and gross-short changes distinguish accumulation, liquidation, new shorts, and covering.
methodology.daily_returns: Daily returns use the same representative contract on adjacent sessions and are compounded without cross-roll price jumps.
methodology.open_interest: Daily open interest is aligned by open_interest_as_of_date; it measures participation, not signed inflow.
methodology.vx_curve: VIX M1/M2/M3 use standard monthly contracts and exclude weekly expiries.
methodology.crowding: Crowding measures historical extremeness independently of directional health.
methodology.missing_history: Unavailable history remains explicit and is never converted to zero or neutral.
